name: obs-mcp
description: Control OBS Studio through 155 current, annotated MCP tools
long_description:
OBS MCP connects compatible MCP clients to OBS Studio through the built-in WebSocket v5 server. It covers the synchronized OBS request surface for scenes, sources, audio, filters, transitions, recording, streaming, canvases, and configuration. Tool discovery remains available while OBS is offline, and the server reconnects in the background.

Requirements:
- Node.js 20.19 or newer
- OBS Studio 28 or newer with WebSocket Server enabled under Tools > WebSocket Server Settings
